timer.heading: Eating Interval Timer
timer.halachicTipText: If you decide to start eating at any point, you never wait more than ~4.5 minutes for the next chime. Once you hear your chime (A or B), take your portion, then simply repeat every time you hear that same chime again!
timer.shiurGuidanceSolid: • Solids (Achila): Up to ~30 cc (approx 2/3 of a matchbox) per interval.
timer.shiurGuidanceLiquid: • Liquids (Shetiya): Up to Melo Logmav (approx 40-45 ml) per interval.

checklist.title: Erev Yom Kippur Setup Checklist
checklist.subtitle: Complete all steps before candle lighting so the app runs untouched for 25+ hours
checklist.step1Desc: Keep screen in fullscreen. The Screen Awake badge confirms display sleep prevention is active.
checklist.step2Title: ⏱️ Set Eating Interval & Fast End Time
checklist.step2Desc: Configure your rabbinic/medical interval (9m, 8m, 6m, 4m) and verify your local Motzei Yom Kippur time in Settings (⚙️) against the calendar provided by your local synagogue.
checklist.step3Desc: If wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor, connect your LibreLinkUp account (or keep Simulated Demo Mode enabled for testing).
checklist.step4Desc: Test Track A, Track B, and Glucose alarms. All chimes auto-silence in 3–5 seconds so no one touches the device on Yom Kippur.
checklist.step5Desc: Press Start Timer before the fast begins so the dual-track countdown begins ticking.
checklist.step6Desc: Click Lock Shield (🛡️) in the top header. This blocks all keyboard keys, mouse wheel, and pets from altering your timer.
checklist.dontShowAgain: Don't show this checklist automatically on startup
checklist.item1: Prepare pre-measured food portions (≤ 30cc) in labeled containers
checklist.item2: Prepare pre-measured liquid cups (≤ 40-45ml / Melo Logmav)
checklist.item3: Plug computer into wall charger (disable auto-sleep in OS settings)
checklist.item4: Test chime volume and audio outputs to ensure audibility from bed/sofa
checklist.item5: Verify LibreLinkUp CGM credentials and confirm live readings display
checklist.item6: Set required Eating Interval (e.g., 9 min) according to your Rabbi's guidance
checklist.item7: Enable Lock Shield (Cat / Touch Shield) before Yom Tov begins
checklist.item8: Keep fast-acting glucose (juice / gel) within arm's reach for emergencies

diagnostics.invalidCredentialsMsg: Abbott rejected the email or password.
diagnostics.invalidCredentialsSuggestion: Please verify that your email and password work when logging into the official LibreLinkUp mobile app. If your LibreView account uses "Sign in with Apple" or Google on your phone, you must set a password on the LibreView website.
diagnostics.regionMismatchMsg: Your account belongs to a different regional server than "{{region}}".
diagnostics.regionMismatchSuggestion: The client attempted automatic regional redirection. If issue persists, try changing the region in Settings (e.g. from US to EU or Global).
diagnostics.termsOfServiceMsg: Abbott requires you to accept updated Terms of Service or Privacy Policy.
diagnostics.termsOfServiceSuggestion: Open the LibreLinkUp mobile app on your smartphone once to accept the updated terms, then re-test the connection here.
diagnostics.noPatientMsg: Login succeeded, but no connected patient or active sensor was found.
diagnostics.noPatientSuggestion: In the LibreLinkUp mobile app, verify that you have accepted the sharing invitation from the sensor wearer.
diagnostics.rateLimitedMsg: Abbott servers are temporarily limiting requests due to rapid attempts.
diagnostics.rateLimitedSuggestion: Please wait 2 to 3 minutes before testing again.
diagnostics.networkTimeoutMsg: Could not connect to Abbott LibreLinkUp servers.
diagnostics.networkTimeoutSuggestion: Please check your computer internet connection and verify that api-us.libreview.io or api-eu.libreview.io is accessible.
diagnostics.sslCertificateErrorMsg: Failed to establish a secure SSL connection to Abbott servers.
diagnostics.sslCertificateErrorSuggestion: If using a filtered internet connection (such as NetFree, Techloq, NetSpark, or Meshimer), ensure your filter's root security certificate is installed in your operating system's trust store or place the certificate file in the application's "certs/" folder.
diagnostics.generalErrorSuggestion: Check your credentials and region settings or inspect the detailed connection log below.
